name: musee
description: Self-hosted photo gallery built with Astro. Ships no client-side JavaScript.
author: Ayaan Zaidi (hi@obviy.us)

scripts.deploy:personal: bun run build && bun run verify:images && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist/ --project-name musee --branch master
scripts.format: oxfmt --check .oxfmtrc.json astro.config.mjs package.json public/site.webmanifest src tsconfig.json
scripts.format:write: oxfmt --write .oxfmtrc.json astro.config.mjs package.json public/site.webmanifest src tsconfig.json
